work.title: Aggregate lifecycle and rework signals
work.description: Calculate attempts by stage, returns by source and destination, Works with repeated Plan or Build attempts, Verify-to-Build and Verify-to-Plan frequency, terminal outcome distribution, abandoned attempts, and average and median stage duration where timestamps exist.
acceptance: Each aggregate can be traced back to source attempts
Invalidated attempts are treated distinctly from failed or returned attempts
Active Works do not appear as terminal failures
Scope can be limited to named Works or Initiatives
